newsitem.title: USA: US late Midwest spot propane gains on cold, EIAs.
newsitem.headline: US late Midwest spot propane gains on cold, EIAs.

text.p: U.S. Midwest spot propane prices gathered more strength by late Thursday following EIA weekly data showing a million-barrel stock draw in the region for the prior week, traders said.

Conway propane was sold for 97.5 cents a gallon, about 1.5 cents higher than Wednesday, helped by continuing cold weather and the EIA data released late Wednesday afternoon showing much-below-normal stocks for the Midwest.
"I think the market will hold because of the low stocks and forecasts of cold weather through the rest of the month," one Conway trader said.

In the Gulf Coast, meanwhile, Mont Belvieu propane was offered at 61.75 cents a gallon, about 0.75 cent higher than Wednesday, helped by slightly firmer crude futures prices and Conway's firmer values.
Gulf prices withstood bearish EIA data showing that region's stocks rising by 400,000 barrels for the week ending Dec 13, players said.
